Requirements: "npm test must stay 15/15 passing; ADD tests for item count, slot counting, note length, file size, freshness, domain check, phrase linter, lowercase addresses".

New plan for test files:
- gate.test.ts: existing 9 test intents, updated plumbing + new tests: item count, slot counting (remainingOnMarket + inFlight), note length, file size, asOf freshness, resolution baseline freshness, domain check, phrase linter. That's ~17 in this file.
- mine.test.ts: existing 6 tests updated (cpi_base_effect mathgen, markov_lead mathgen, verifySources good/bad → use LIVE_FIXTURES, submitter guard, submitDraft refuses triple guard) + new: match_lead_elo mathgen, verify figure cross-check (comma/period), refreshers-parse-live-fixtures tests (wiki, go milestone by title incl. negative #305 guard, destatis figures), evidence-log lowercase + mode-tag tests.

There will be ~30 tests total. Let me write both test files.
